title: SpaceTraders systems
description: The systems the SpaceTraders bot knows, its exploring through jump gates, the command ship's and then the explorers', the uncharted waypoints they chart, and what each system offers for mining, trading and ships (Gemberkoekje/projects SpaceTraders/PLAN.md slices 6.11 and 6.30).

list.name: reset_date
list.label: Reset
list.description: The server reset whose run the dashboard shows, newest first (slice 2.13): every series carries it as reset_date and every log line as ResetDate, so runs never mix. Tick several to compare runs. Data from before slice 2.13 has no reset date and shows under none.

panels.title: Systems known
panels.description: Home, every system the command ship explored, and every system a gate it asked connects to.

panels.title: Explored
panels.description: Systems whose every market and shipyard the command ship visited once; home counts once the explore plan runs.

panels.title: To explore
panels.description: Known systems behind a built gate that no exploring ship has explored yet. Those within the trade reach of home (Trade.MaxHaulDistance jumps) are explored first (slice 6.30, D103).

panels.title: Gates under construction
panels.description: Known systems whose gate isn't built: no jump to them until it is. The plan looks at them again hourly.

panels.title: Antimatter bought (24h)
panels.description: Credits the jumps cost: each buys one ANTIMATTER at the gate it leaves.

panels.title: Probes abroad

targets.expr: sum(spacetraders_system_probes{namespace="spacetraders", reset_date=~"$reset_date"} and on (system) (spacetraders_system_jumps_from_home{namespace="spacetraders", reset_date=~"$reset_date"} > 0)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Our probes in systems other than home, which keep those markets' prices fresh (slice 6.28, D97): home's markets get theirs first, then those of the explored systems within the trade reach (Trade.MaxHaulDistance jumps of home), then the others after the drones and cargo ships that take turns, as the credit reserve allows. Never bought where a shipyard has SHIP_PROBE at SCARCE.

panels.title: Command ship

targets.expr: max by (location, activity) (spacetraders_ship_info{namespace="spacetraders", reset_date=~"$reset_date"} and on (ship) max by (ship) (spacetraders_ship_status_since_timestamp_seconds{namespace="spacetraders", role="COMMAND", reset_date=~"$reset_date"}))

panels.description: Where the command ship is and what it does. It explores until the first explorer is bought, which it fetches from the shipyard that sells one, then jumps home and works there (slice 6.30, D98).

panels.title: Systems left
panels.description: The systems the explore plan knows, hasn't explored and reaches from home through built gates (slice 6.30, D102), as its last pass counted them: what the explorers are bought for.

panels.title: Explorers wanted
panels.description: One explorer for every Explore.SystemsPerExplorer (10) systems left, rounded up, at most Explore.MaxExplorers (5) (D102). The first is bought before the probes, and the command ship fetches it; every further one after the drones and cargo ships that take turns, once a probe of ours is in the shipyard's system (see the purchase order on the SpaceTraders dashboard).

panels.title: Explorers

targets.expr: count(max by (ship) (spacetraders_ship_status_since_timestamp_seconds{namespace="spacetraders", role=~"(SHIP_)?EXPLORER", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})) or vector(0)

panels.description: The explorers the fleet has (SHIP_EXPLORER; EXPLORER after a restart). With no system left for it, an explorer trades where it is until one turns up (D102).

panels.title: Chart rewards (24h)
panels.description: What charting paid in the last 24 hours (slice 6.30, D99). An exploring ship charts every uncharted waypoint that can hold a market or shipyard (not asteroids or gas giants), the gate first; the reward is the credits after a chart less those before it. The Charted lines are in the exploring journal.

panels.title: Explorers

targets.expr: max by (ship, location, activity) (spacetraders_ship_info{namespace="spacetraders", reset_date=~"$reset_date"} and on (ship) max by (ship) (spacetraders_ship_status_since_timestamp_seconds{namespace="spacetraders", role=~"(SHIP_)?EXPLORER", reset_date=~"$reset_date"}))

panels.description: Where each explorer is and what it does: exploring a system, jumping towards one, or trading while no system is left for it (slice 6.30, D102). Each takes a system no other exploring ship has taken, those within the trade reach of home first (D103).

panels.title: Systems

targets.expr: max by (system, state, gate_state) (spacetraders_system_info{namespace="spacetraders", system=~"$system", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})

panels.description: Every system the bot knows: what the explore plan knows of it, how many jumps from home, when it was explored, and what is there. probes: our probes there, which keep its markets' prices fresh (slice 6.28: home's markets first, then those of the explored systems the gates reach, the nearest first). oldest prices: how old the oldest prices of its markets are (the trade across systems of slice 6.29 counts only prices at most 30 minutes old, D96). Its best trade margin is per unit, before fuel.

panels.title: Mining and siphoning

targets.expr: max by (system, good, market) (spacetraders_system_raw_good_price{namespace="spacetraders", system=~"$system", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})

panels.description: What can be mined or siphoned in each system, and which ores and gases its markets buy: at how many asteroids (by their deposits) or gas giants, the best price a market pays and where, and the lowest supply among the markets that buy it. SCARCE pays a drone most.

panels.title: Trades

targets.expr: max by (system, good, buy_at, sell_at) (spacetraders_system_trade_margin{namespace="spacetraders", system=~"$system", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})
max by (system, good, buy_at, sell_at) (spacetraders_system_trade_volume{namespace="spacetraders", system=~"$system", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})

panels.description: The best trades within each system, one per good, the five best: buy where it is cheapest, sell where it pays most, margin per unit before fuel, and the units one trade moves (the smaller trade volume).

panels.title: Shipyards

targets.expr: max by (system, waypoint, ship_type) (spacetraders_shipyard_ship_type{namespace="spacetraders", system=~"$system", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})
max by (system, waypoint, ship_type) (spacetraders_shipyard_ship_price{namespace="spacetraders", system=~"$system", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})
max by (system, waypoint, ship_type) (spacetraders_shipyard_ship_supply{namespace="spacetraders", system=~"$system", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})

panels.description: The ship types each shipyard sells, with price and supply as last seen there.

panels.title: Gates

targets.expr: max by (system, to, state) (spacetraders_system_connection_info{namespace="spacetraders", system=~"$system", reset_date=~"$reset_date"} * on (to) group_left (state) label_replace(max by (system, state) (spacetraders_system_info{namespace="spacetraders", reset_date=~"$reset_date"}), "to", "$1", "system", "(.*)"))

panels.description: Which systems each known gate connects to, and what is known of the system at the other end.

panels.title: Systems over time
panels.description: How exploring goes: systems explored, and those known but not explored yet.

panels.title: Exploring journal

targets.expr: {namespace="spacetraders"} | json EventKind, Plan, Reason, ResetDate, ShipName, message="[\"@m\"]" | EventKind=~"Jumped|SystemExplored|Charted|Warped|SystemsScanned" or Plan="Explore" or Reason=~"jump_refused|warp_refused" | ResetDate=~"$reset_date" | line_format "{{ if .ShipName }}[{{ .ShipName }}] {{ end }}{{ .message }}"

panels.description: The explore plan's journal: jumps (with what the antimatter cost), warps (slice 6.31: with the fuel and seconds each took against those the research note reckons), scans for the systems around an explorer, systems explored, charts with their rewards, the plan taking the command ship or an explorer and letting it go, the command ship fetching the first explorer and coming home, waits for credits, and jumps and warps the API refused. A line about a ship starts with the bot's own name for it, in brackets (slice 2.14).
